findings.evidenceJa: これは自分だけの問題だ
findings.governingReading: this is a problem for Shirou alone
findings.explanation: The exclusivity motivating his decision to conceal the fight from Rin is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: いずれ敵になるって話
findings.governingReading: the understanding that they would eventually become enemies
findings.explanation: A conditional future relationship is hardened into an explicit mutual promise to fight.

findings.governingReading: Shirou as an incomplete or half-fledged practitioner
findings.explanation: His self-criticism as unfinished is generalized to lack of professional status.

findings.highlight: as if to cut off my regret
findings.governingReading: as though severing his lingering attachment
findings.explanation: The emotional tie he forces himself to abandon is narrowed to regret.

findings.evidenceJa: 柳洞寺か間桐邸に忍び込んで
findings.governingReading: infiltrate either Ryuudou Temple or the Matou residence
findings.explanation: One of Shirou’s two planned investigation sites disappears.

findings.governingReading: reliable or definite information
findings.explanation: The evidentiary certainty Shirou needs is reduced to general usefulness.

findings.highlight: a few day’s worth of groceries
findings.governingReading: several days’ worth of shopping
findings.explanation: The plural duration is given an incorrect singular possessive.

findings.governingReading: a loudly called, drawn-out “I’m hooome”
findings.explanation: Shirou’s audible arrival announcement is flattened.

findings.governingReading: an unpleasant sense that something is wrong
findings.explanation: The foreboding sensory judgment is weakened to generic strangeness.

findings.governingReading: whoever the intruder was, without known gender
findings.explanation: The intruder is assigned male gender before Shirou has identified anyone.

findings.governingReading: Shirou intuitively reconstructs Sakura’s presence; no blood is active here
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts blood into the living room before the Japanese provides any such evidence.

findings.highlight: as if someone coughed up blood here
findings.governingReading: Sakura had been in the living room; no cause or blood source is stated
findings.explanation: The English invents a specific respiratory injury scenario.

findings.governingReading: traces of an intruder
findings.explanation: The mature branch again adds blood beside the actual intruder evidence.

findings.highlight: It’s more strange not to draw a conclusion
findings.evidenceJa: 結論が出ない方がおかしい
findings.governingReading: it would be stranger not to reach the conclusion
findings.explanation: The comparative is formed unidiomatically.

findings.highlight: Calmly think, and I can tell
findings.evidenceJa: 冷静になって考えれば
findings.governingReading: if he calms down and thinks, he can read what happened
findings.explanation: The English turns a failed conditional effort into a malformed imperative.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺にだけ都合のいい話
findings.governingReading: a story convenient only for Shirou
findings.explanation: The selfish asymmetry driving his guilt is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 電話の呼び鈴が鳴り響く
findings.governingReading: the telephone bell rings out through the house
findings.explanation: The call’s intrusive resonant force is removed.

findings.governingReading: Shinji’s voice sounds openly amused or entertained
findings.explanation: His enjoyment of Shirou’s distress becomes benign cheerfulness.

findings.highlight: I only took back what’s mine
findings.governingReading: she is Shinji’s sister
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces the sibling justification with an explicit ownership claim over Sakura.

findings.governingReading: because she is his younger sister
findings.explanation: The family relationship Shinji invokes disappears from the mature variant.

findings.governingReading: let’s settle this once and for all
findings.explanation: The idiom for resolving their conflict becomes unnatural tournament language.

findings.governingReading: Shirou lost Saber
findings.explanation: A loss whose final ontological status remains uncertain is stated as elimination.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜を強引に連れ戻した
findings.governingReading: forcibly brought Sakura back
findings.explanation: The mature variant upgrades the inferred coercive return into the legally and factually stronger claim of kidnapping.

findings.highlight: that would depend on what you do
findings.evidenceJa: 大事な妹にどうもしないさ
findings.governingReading: he claims he will do nothing to his precious sister
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces Shinji’s disavowal with an explicit conditional threat.

findings.highlight: You know what that means, right?
findings.evidenceJa: おまえが一人で僕のところに迎えに来るなら
findings.governingReading: if Shirou comes alone to retrieve her
findings.explanation: An additional menacing implication is inserted after the solo condition.

findings.highlight: don’t try to pull any shit with me
findings.evidenceJa: 下手な考えは起こすな
findings.governingReading: do not entertain any foolish scheme
findings.explanation: Shinji’s warning is made substantially more vulgar and aggressive.

findings.highlight: I can’t guarantee what’ll happen to her
findings.evidenceJa: おまえが桜の前でそんな卑怯な真似をするとは思ってない
findings.governingReading: Shinji says he does not expect Shirou to act so cowardly before Sakura
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces a taunt about Shirou’s honor with a direct threat to Sakura.

findings.governingReading: a muffled laugh over the receiver
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts an offscreen pain cry absent from the source.

findings.governingReading: a muffled laugh; no kick is described
findings.explanation: The English invents a violent offscreen impact and leaves its target ambiguous.

findings.highlight: Don’t do anything else to Sakura
findings.governingReading: do not lay a hand on Sakura
findings.explanation: “Anything else” presupposes that Shinji has already harmed her, which Shirou does not yet know.

findings.evidenceJa: できるだけ早く来いよ
findings.governingReading: come as quickly as possible
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents agreement to an exchange rather than Shinji simply urging speed.

findings.highlight: any other things to do to her that I haven’t already tried
findings.evidenceJa: 大事な僕の妹を待たせる
findings.governingReading: making Shinji’s precious sister wait
findings.explanation: The mature branch invents a claim that Shinji has already exhausted imaginable abuses of Sakura.

findings.highlight: I got bored with punching her
findings.governingReading: Nothing?
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents repeated physical assault on Sakura.

findings.evidenceJa: ライダーを抑えるのに必死だよ
findings.governingReading: Shinji is desperately restraining Rider
findings.explanation: The English reverses restraint into deliberately handing Sakura over.

findings.evidenceJa: ご馳走を前にしたような顔
findings.governingReading: Rider looks as though facing a feast
findings.explanation: A predatory expression is converted into a completed bite to Sakura’s neck.

findings.evidenceJa: なんで、直接俺にこない
findings.governingReading: why did Shinji not come directly at Shirou
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces Shirou’s tactical question with an accusation of completed harm.

findings.governingReading: he kicks off against the ground
findings.explanation: The physical launch driven by anger is generalized into departure.

findings.evidenceJa: 怒りで千切れそうな神経
findings.governingReading: nerves that feel ready to snap from anger
findings.explanation: The breaking-point quality of Shirou’s anger is omitted.

findings.governingReading: the incidents moved dismissal time earlier
findings.explanation: A changed student schedule becomes closure of the institution.

findings.highlight: there are no students or teachers
findings.evidenceJa: 残ってはいないだろう
findings.governingReading: there are probably no students or even teachers remaining
findings.explanation: Shirou’s expectation is promoted into observed certainty.

findings.highlight: There’s hot steel in my back
findings.evidenceJa: 背中には熱い鉄が入っている
findings.governingReading: there is hot iron in his back
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes the material in Shirou’s circuit-activation image.

findings.highlight: The Magic Circuit is already made
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術回路はとっくに成っている
findings.governingReading: his Magic Circuits have long since formed or activated
findings.explanation: Plural internal circuits are turned into one newly manufactured object.

findings.governingReading: his sole permitted technique, Reinforcement, with “weapon” as its reading
findings.explanation: The Fate-specific technique disappears beneath its ruby-level metaphor.

findings.highlight: He has to be in the classroom on the third floor
findings.evidenceJa: あいつがいるとすれば三階の教室だ
findings.governingReading: if Shinji is anywhere, it will be the third-floor classroom
findings.explanation: A character-based prediction is made necessary fact.

findings.governingReading: in front of class 2-C
findings.explanation: The school location is rendered as though the classroom were a numbered room or chamber.

findings.governingReading: his head becomes white-hot
findings.explanation: A heat-and-light image of rage is changed into boiling physiology.

findings.highlight: I have to check if she’s all right
findings.evidenceJa: 一刻も早く、桜の無事を確かめる
findings.governingReading: he must confirm Sakura’s safety without losing another instant
findings.explanation: The urgency of Shirou’s sole focus is omitted.

findings.highlight: I read its course with amazing speed and avoid it
findings.evidenceJa: 自分でも驚くほどの先読みで躱した
findings.governingReading: he evades through anticipation so acute it surprises even himself
findings.explanation: Predictive combat reading is changed into processing speed.

findings.governingReading: the dagger slashing upward
findings.explanation: The attack direction that defines Shirou’s evasion is omitted.

findings.governingReading: he believes he has seized the opening
findings.explanation: The abrupt English implies successful capture of Shinji before Shirou even reaches the Command Spell.

findings.governingReading: the Command Spells controlling Rider
findings.explanation: The controlling marks are singularized again.

findings.highlight: My tongue bulges from my mouth
findings.governingReading: his tongue protrudes or stretches out under strangulation
findings.explanation: The choking reaction is changed from extension to swelling.

findings.evidenceJa: 集中力を侮っていました
findings.governingReading: I underestimated his concentration
findings.explanation: Rider’s precise admission is rendered in unnatural English.

findings.highlight: I can’t do anything to resist
findings.evidenceJa: 抵抗しようにも踏ん張れない
findings.governingReading: he cannot brace his feet even to attempt resistance
findings.explanation: A specific mechanical reason for helplessness becomes total incapacity.

findings.evidenceJa: 無残に砕かれる、骨の音
findings.governingReading: the sound of bones being brutally crushed
findings.explanation: The mature variant specifies Shirou’s neck where the source leaves the crushed bones unnamed.
